text.p: Salton/Maxim Housewares Inc said Tuesday that it signed an exclusive worldwide distribution agreement with Windmere-Durable Holdings Inc to market electric products under the Farberware brand name.
The agreement is pursuant to a sub-license agreement for Farberware electric products with Windmere-Durable.

"We believe this exclusive distribution agreement provides Salton/Maxim with a significant market edge," Leonhard Dreimann, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "In addition, we expect the agreement will lead to increased market share as we leverage Farberware's well known, respected name in high-end distribution to department stores, specialty retailers and upscale catalogs, as well as an exclusive agreement with Service Merchandise (Co Inc ) at the discount department store level."
Salton/Maxim is a diversified household and personal care appliances company.
